adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the mutation explicitly permits non-organizers to add guests (team admin/owner, organizer, or any attendee). However, the calendar update is performed via `const credentials = await getUsersCredentials(ctx.user); const eventManager = new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] }); await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` where `user` is the caller (`ctx.user`), not the booking organizer. The booking organizer is fetched separately (`organizer`) and `booking.user` is included with `credentials`, but neither is used to build the `EventManager`. If the caller is an attendee/team member, this will attempt to update the organizer’s event using the wrong account/credentials and is likely to fail or update the wrong calendar.
